summary: News Corporation filed a routine 8-K on September 8, 2026, disclosing daily ASX repurchase information under its existing $1 billion stock repurchase program covering Class A (NWSA) and Class B (NWS) common stock. No new authorization, price, or share count is stated in the excerpt; exhibits 99.1 and 99.2 simply reproduce the daily ASX disclosures. The program remains subject to market conditions and applicable securities laws, with no advisor or board recommendation cited. Watch for periodic buyback pace and any future authorization increase as signals of capital-return intensity.
